textos.Muitos espectadores relatam que o filme: Many viewers report that the film drags, with long, repetitive scenes that make the experience boring, and that its length could be cut without loss.
textos.Personagens irritantes e falta de profun: Irritating characters and lack of depth
textos.As críticas apontam que os personagens,: The reviews point out that the characters, especially the central couple, are one-dimensional and that their reactions come across as exaggerated or infantilized, making it hard for the audience to connect.
textos.Mensagem sobre papéis de gênero e mascul: Message on gender roles and fragile masculinity
textos.Vários comentários consideram que a abor: Several comments consider the treatment of gender issues simplistic or poorly developed, at times accusing the film of misogyny, at others of reinforcing stereotypes superficially.
textos.O texto é descrito como pouco natural, c: The writing is described as unnatural, with dialogue that does not sound authentic and a plot that does not fully explore the implications of the central conflict.
textos.A conclusão é vista como insatisfatória,: The conclusion is seen as unsatisfying, confusing or contradicting the earlier development, leaving the feeling that the film did not know how to close its questions.
textos.Fotografia e paisagens como único ponto: Cinematography and landscapes as the only positive
textos.A qualidade visual, com belas imagens de: The visual quality, with beautiful images of mountains and snow, is often praised, but insufficient to make up for the other problems pointed out.
textos.Masculinidade frágil e egoísmo do protag: Fragile masculinity and the protagonist's selfishness
textos.Várias reviews deste grupo criticam o co: Several reviews in this group criticize the protagonist's behavior, describing him as a man who flees danger and then denies what happened, revealing a fragile, self-centered masculinity that his wife and children have to put up with.
textos.O filme é frequentemente descrito como l: The film is often described as slow and dragging, with a second half that stretches on needlessly, making the experience tiring despite the interesting premise.
textos.A fotografia das montanhas cobertas de n: The cinematography of the snow-covered mountains and the hotel interiors is praised for its beauty and coldness, contributing to the film's clinical, alienating atmosphere.
textos.Roteiro superficial e falta de desenvolv: Superficial script and lack of development
textos.Algumas reviews apontam que o roteiro nã: Some reviews point out that the script does not go deeper into the themes it proposes, staying on the surface and leaving important questions unexplored, such as the psychology of the female characters.
textos.O final é visto como decepcionante ou se: The ending is seen as disappointing or lacking impact, with some viewers feeling that the resolution does not match the tension built up over the narrative.
textos.Comparações com outras obras de Östlund: Comparisons with other works by Östlund
textos.Diversas reviews comparam este filme a o: Several reviews compare this film with other works by the director, such as Triangle of Sadness and Force Majeure, considering it inferior or less engaging.
textos.Várias reviews destacam como o filme exa: Several reviews highlight how the film examines male fragility and ego, showing a character who cannot own up to his mistakes and turns his own guilt into victimhood.
textos.Crítica aos papéis de gênero e ao casame: Critique of gender roles and marriage
textos.O grupo aponta que a obra levanta questõ: The group points out that the work raises questions about gender roles, social expectations and the dynamics of marriage, leaving the viewer unsure about who is right.
textos.Muitas reviews descrevem a experiência c: Many reviews describe the experience as uncomfortable and funny at the same time, with embarrassing situations that produce nervous laughter and tension.
textos.A fotografia é elogiada, com planos long: The cinematography is praised, with long shots and framings that explore space and the characters' positions, in addition to striking mountain landscapes and interiors.
textos.As atuações são bastante elogiadas, com: The performances are widely praised, with emphasis on the naturalness and the cast's ability to sustain long, emotionally intense moments.
textos.Algumas reviews mencionam um ritmo lento: Some reviews mention a slow pace and an ending that did not please everyone, although they acknowledge that the approach works for what the film sets out to do.

textos.Lançado em 2014 e dirigido por Ruben Öst: Released in 2014 and directed by Ruben Östlund, the drama Force Majeure follows a Swedish family on a ski vacation in the mountains. During a lunch at the resort restaurant, an imminent avalanche destabilizes their life together, putting Tomas and Ebba's marriage to the test as the husband tries at all costs to maintain his role as patriarch.
textos.A produção estrutura-se a partir de um r: The production is built on a contemplative, slow pace, set amid the coldness of snowy landscapes. The experience is marked by a constant atmosphere of discomfort and social tension among those present.
textos.Na grande maioria das notas (~80%), boa: In the vast majority of ratings (~80%), a good portion of the accounts praise the way the work examines fragile masculinity and the swings of the male ego. A significant share stresses the discussions it provokes about gender roles and expectations in marriage, while several underline the presence of an awkward humor that heightens the feeling of embarrassment.
textos.Numa parcela das notas (~17%), a perspec: In a share of the ratings (~17%), the perspective becomes more reserved: many draw attention to the protagonist's selfishness and fragility in the face of events. However, a considerable number consider that the slow pace and excessive length make the narrative tiring, even though a good portion values the visual quality of the cinematography and the mountain settings.
textos.Em tom de rejeição, numa fração mínima d: In a tone of rejection, within a minimal fraction of the ratings (~4%), about half point to the dragging pace and excessive length as decisive flaws of the experience. In addition, a significant share criticizes the superficiality and attitudes of the characters, while many judge the message around gender roles and fragile masculinity shallow or problematic.
